summary: Central Puerto S.A. filed a Form 6-K announcing the timing of its third-quarter 2026 earnings release and conference call. Results are scheduled to be released on Wednesday, November 11, 2026, the first business day after the November 6 board meeting, with a call on November 12 at 10:00 a.m. ET. The schedule accounts for Argentine Emergency Decree No. 1103/2026 holidays. No transaction, stake, price, or advisor is disclosed. This is a routine earnings-timing notice, not a special situation; no deal terms or risk-arb angle apply.
